For Milestone 1, "Establishing Physical Lab," we have achieved the following results, meeting the "Outputs," "Acceptance Criteria," and "Evidence of Milestone Completion":
Lab Equipment Procurement:
・The laboratory is fully prepared and equipped for the upcoming courses.
・Video of Installed Lab: https://x.com/CardanoSolar/status/1801353012302037435

Cardano Foundation official post about the ALBA (ADA Labs for Blockchain Applications) Laboratory:
https://x.com/Cardano_CF/status/1801331953280393605
Network and Infrastructure Setup:
・The network and infrastructure are configured and operational. Additionally, we have installed a monitor to display real-time operations of the Cardano node within the lab for students to observe.
・Photos of Prepared Physical Space:

https://docs.google.com/document/d/19LmOUQ-vpYbhUkCcOq30Q01hEVxyTWfN-HZIu3F3jn0
Cardano Node Installation:
・The Cardano node is installed and synchronized in mainnet environment: 
・Screenshots of Tip Querie/Node Synchronized:

https://docs.google.com/document/d/1jqgNC4hJwc2w2X_gv9of2Q9JKk4DfPMCIisLprujeZQ
Video of the Bare Metal (Physical) Cardano Node installed, historical moment recorded:
https://x.com/CardanoSolar/status/1801597418070257894
In consultation with the IOG education team, we decided to use Demeter instead of the Testnet. Demeter provides all necessary resources to interact with the blockchain out of the box, including cloud-based workspaces and starter kits for development. We established an agreement with TX Pipe to use Demeter as our development and testing environment for all the students at the courses.
Additional Achievements:
・Agreement with Cardano Foundation and IOG:

・Through UTN, we have signed an agreement with the Cardano Foundation and IOG to conduct the first Aiken course on July 15, with participants from various Latin American countries already registered.

https://docs.google.com/document/d/1fmQPSlUpJdLUxearf4ES86JRLiWGT7cBylwHlqki79E

ms.report:
Proof of Achievement Description:
For Milestone 2, "Developing Educational Programs," we have achieved the following outcomes, meeting the "Outputs," "Acceptance Criteria," and "Evidence of Milestone Completion":
・Blockchain Curriculum:

・We made an agreement to use the Cardano Academy from the Cardano Foundation at UTN:

CF Press release title: "UTN adds to several different educational initiatives from the Cardano Foundation including its own Cardano Academy"
https://cardanofoundation.org/blog/cardano-foundation-reveals-newest-education-partner
According to the terms of use of the Cardano Academy (https://academy.cardanofoundation.org/terms-and-conditions) indicates that while individual use is generally permitted, institutional or mass usage, particularly within a public institution such as UTN, is not explicitly covered. The terms specify that any use beyond the individual educational purposes described in the agreement necessitates express permission from the Cardano Foundation.
・Curriculum Document: https://academy.cardanofoundation.org/overview

・Aiken Course Content:

・Together with the IOG education team, we have prepared the curriculum to educate students in Aiken.
・Lecture Presentations and Course Content: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1OAtLs6jVX8BeCEDnxyclunOoiKHqIoI7/

https://es.cointelegraph.com/news/argentina-cardano-foundation-and-utn-to-collaborate-to-expand-blockchain-education-and-adoption
